integrity: Algebraic proof and a standard-library exact-rational checker are supplied. Computations corroborate rather than prove the universal result. No independent audit or field verification.
scientific_limitations: Structural population-law identification on known-occupied sites under a homogeneous stationary two-state availability chain, equal visit spacing, common conditionally independent detection, and no false positives. The inverse fails when Markov memory is zero and deteriorates near that boundary. Does not establish finite-sample robustness, ecological persistence, or validity with site heterogeneity. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Three count-only visits identify Markov availability and detection except at zero temporal memory
